content: Implement the Verilog module based on the following description. Assume that signals are positive clock/clk edge triggered unless otherwise stated.

Consider the following implementation of an 8-bit 2-to-1 mux:

  module TopModule (
      input        sel,
      input  [7:0] a,
      input  [7:0] b,
      output       out
  );

      assign out = (~sel & a) | (sel & b);

  endmodule

Unfortunately, this module has a bug. Implement a new version of this
module that fixes the bug.

```verilog
module TopModule (
    input        sel,
    input  [7:0] a,
    input  [7:0] b,
    output [7:0] out
);

    assign out = sel ? b : a;

endmodule
```

The original module had two related bugs:

1. `out` was declared as a 1-bit output instead of an 8-bit output.
2. `sel` was used directly in bitwise operations without being replicated to 8 bits, so only the LSB of `a` and `b` would be selected.

The corrected version declares `out` as `[7:0]` and uses a ternary mux to select the full 8-bit value.
